MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  May 28, 2024
 NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action
 taken by the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the
 only record of official City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they
 are approved by the City Council at its next regularly scheduled meeting.

 CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing
 Authority, Library Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

 Called to Order 5:01 pm

 CLOSED SESSION

  CS1.  Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation: Janice Kronik Gath, et. al v.
  Mission Viejo OCSC Case No. 30-2024-01376969-CU-MC-CJC and related injunction
  action

  CS2.  Conference with Legal Counsel: Threat to Public Services or Facilities; Consultation
  with City Attorney and Director of Information Technology David Meyer

 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

 INVOCATION: Mayor Kelley

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Vasquez

 PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Proclaim the Month of May To Be Jewish American Heritage Month

  Presented proclamation to Dr. Mark Cymerint.

  P2.  Recognize OCSD Medal of Valor Recipients and Mothers Against Drunk Driving
  Award Recipients

  Presented certificates of commendation to Deputy Jesus Carrasco, Deputy Juan Contreras
  and Deputy Brandon Espinosa for the Medal of Valor; Deputy Kassy Jacobs, Deputy
  Stacy Cole and Deputy Casey Briggs for the Medal of Lifesaving; and Deputy
  Jesus Carrasco, and Deputy Adam Zellers for the Mothers Against Drunk Driving Award.

City Council Summary  1  May 28, 2024
   P3.  Proclaim "Drowning Prevention Awareness" for the Months of May Through August
  2024

  Presented proclamation to Battalion Chief Jason Taylor.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS
 CONSENT CALENDAR

 B/G
  1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of May 14, 2024, as presented.

  2.  General Check Register Dated May 3, 2024 in the Amount of $4,321,062.03

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  3.  General Check Register Dated May 10, 2024 in the Amount of $988,550.02

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  4.  Golf Check Register Dated May 3, 2024 in the Amount of $268,067.12

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  5.  Golf Check Register Dated May 10, 2024 in the Amount of $14,735.77

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  6.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo - Third Quarter 2023-24

  Received and filed.

  7.  Integrated Library Systems Renewal and SaaS Migration

  (1) Approved 5-year agreement with SirsiDynix (A24-16) for Integrated Library Systems
  (ILS) Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) migration; (2) approved purchase orders to SirsiDynix
  in a total amount not to exceed $132,116 for year 1 ILS SaaS products, and migration
  services; and (3) approved purchase orders to SirsiDynix for years 2-5 annual ILS service
  renewals in an amount not to exceed $509,117.

  8.  Community Outreach and Engagement Contract

  Approved the Community Outreach and Engagement Partnership Agreement with the cities
  of Laguna Hills (A24-17) and Rancho Santa Margarita (A24-18).

City Council Summary  2  May 28, 2024
   9.  (CIP 23338) - Event Structure in the Garden+Grille at the Oso Creek Golf Course -
  Phase II

  (1) Approved a change order to S. Parker Engineering in an amount not to exceed $120,000,
  and (2) adopted Resolution 24-21 Amending the Oso Creek Golf Course Fiscal Year 2023-
  2024 Budget for CIP 23338 to fund the assembly, footings, and paving for the event structure
  at the Garden+Grille.

  10.  2024 Fourth of July Community Street Faire

  Approved the Special Events Permit submitted by the Mission Viejo Activities Committee
  authorizing the annual Mission Viejo Fourth of July Community Street Faire on Thursday,
  July 4, 2024.

 ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

 NEW BUSINESS

  11.  Employment Agreement for City Manager

  R/B  (1) Received Oral report and summary of recommendation of new City Manager employment
  agreement with Elaine S. L. Lister per Government Code Section 54953(c)(3); (2) approved
  the City Manager Employment Agreement between the City of Mission Viejo and Elaine
  Lister (A24-19), and (3) authorized the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

 MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  12.  Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Report

  Received written report.

 STAFF REPORTS

  13.  Orange County Sheriff's Department (OCSD) Update from Chief Ivins

  Received report.

 CITY MANAGERS REPORTS

 CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  14.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  Received reports.

 Council Member Bucknum

City Council Summary  3  May 28, 2024
  Council Member Goodell

 Council Member Vasquez

 Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch

 Mayor Kelley

 ADJOURNMENT AT 7:52 PM TO TUESDAY June 11, 2024 at 5:00 PM.

City Council Summary  4  May 28, 2024
